name: Varroc Engineering Ltd
title: Varroc Engineering Ltd - 541578 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 12.8% with India EBITDA up 14% and overseas up 24%, but group PBT margin only 4.5% and net debt rose to INR 495 crore; FY27 capex guided INR 450-500 crore, next year INR 300-400 crore.

capex.quote: The CapEx, I think overall will be at least to the tune of between INR 450-500 crores, is what we see as the overall CapEx for this year.

triggers.label: Overseas order book ~INR 1,400 crore
triggers.quote: The overseas order book for this year was around close to INR 1,400 crore.

triggers.label: Net working capital stress; net debt up INR 115 crore
triggers.quote: Also some temporary challenges in net working capital, which should get corrected in the coming quarters.

triggers.label: Debt held at INR 500-600 crore; zero debt targeted FY28
triggers.quote: The average debt could be in the range of INR 500 crore-INR 600 crore, more or less at the current levels or slightly upwards.

triggers.label: Tier 2/3 supplier shortages; normalising after 15 May
triggers.quote: It's mainly to do with bought-out components, not so much with the raw material.

guidance.quote: Should we expect a mid to high teen growth in FY 2027?
In FY 2027, margins will be higher than what we reported in FY 2026.
The CapEx, I think overall will be at least to the tune of between INR 450-500 crores
We should move to a zero debt status by end of next year.

guidance.value: Romania EBITDA breakeven by Q4 FY27; Italy forging ~1 year
guidance.quote: Only in Romania we have significant challenge, and we should reach EBITDA breakeven by Q4.

red_flags.label: Auto industry growth not matched; Karma Capital notes lagging volumes
red_flags.quote: somehow, we've not been able to participate in the industry growth which we have seen

red_flags.label: Tier 2/3 supply disruption
red_flags.quote: Tier 2, Tier 3, is where we are facing challenges.

red_flags.label: Auditor qualification on TYC arbitration
red_flags.quote: there's still a point in our auditor's report with regards to that.

evasions.topic: Growth vs industry and largest customer
evasions.quote: That is essentially why I would say through Q4, we are a little bit behind.
We don't want to give any specific timeframe to it.
